title: Unravelling tumour heterogeneity using next-generation imaging: radiomics, radiogenomics, and habitat imaging

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Unravelling tumour heterogeneity using next-generation imaging: radiomics, radiogenomics, and habitat imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Tumour heterogeneity in cancers has been observed at the histological and genetic levels, and increased levels of intra-tumour genetic heterogeneity have been reported to be associated with adverse clinical outcomes.
